'''Sethurathnam Ravi''', also known as S Ravi, is an Indian [[Chartered Accountants Act, 1949|chartered accountant (CA)]], the promoter and managing partner of Ravi Rajan & Co. LLP, and the former Chairman of the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sethurathnam Ravi: Positions, Relations and Network - MarketScreener |url=https://www.marketscreener.com/insider/SETHURATHNAM-RAVI-A0IDV6/ |access-date=2024-12-05 |website=www.marketscreener.com |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2017-11-14 |title=BSE appoints S Ravi as its new chairman |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/bse-appoints-s-ravi-as-its-new-chairman/articleshow/61646087.cms |access-date=2024-12-05 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref> He is a prominent figure in the Indian financial sector and serves on the boards of numerous [[companies]] and [[organization]]s.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Tourism Finance Corporation Of India Ltd. |url=https://www.tfciltd.com/about-boardofdirectors |access-date=2024-12-05 |website=www.tfciltd.com}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Sethurathnam Ravi did his schooling from the  [[St. Aloysius Senior Secondary School]], Jabalpur, and completed his Bachelor’s and Master’s degree in [[Commerce]] from [[Rani Durgavati Vishwavidyalaya|Durgavati University]], [[Madhya Pradesh]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sethurathnam Ravi: Positions, Relations and Network - MarketScreener |url=https://www.marketscreener.com/insider/SETHURATHNAM-RAVI-A0IDV6/ |access-date=2024-12-05 |website=www.marketscreener.com |language=en-US}}</ref> He is a Fellow Member of the [[The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India|Institute of Chartered Accountants of India]] (ICAI) and holds qualifications as an [[Information technology audit|Information Systems Auditor]] (DISA). Ravi is also an Insolvency Resolution Professional registered with the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-01-18 |title=Our banks should come together overseas |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/opinion/our-banks-should-come-together-overseas/article20961100.ece1 |access-date=2024-12-05 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}</ref>

== Career ==
Ravi has held significant positions throughout his career, most notably as the Chairman of the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE).<ref>{{Cite web |title=BSE ने एस रवि को नियुक्त किया नया चेयरमैन - |url=https://www.jagran.com/business/biz-bse-appoints-s-ravi-as-its-new-chairman-17031053.html |access-date=2024-12-05 |website=Jagran |language=hi}}</ref> He has served on the boards of several prominent institutions, including [[IDBI Bank]], LIC, ONGC, [[Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited|BHEL]], and others.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-11-04 |title=Neo banks can change banking landscape; why year 2021 will be crucial for Indian banks {{!}} INTERVIEW |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/business/banking-finance-neo-banks-can-change-banking-landscape-why-year-2021-will-be-crucial-for-indian-banks-interview-2120799/ |access-date=2024-12-05 |website=Financialexpress |language=en}}</ref> Ravi has also been a member of the [[Securities and Exchange Board of India]] (SEBI) Takeover Panel and the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).<ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-01-18 |title=Our banks should come together overseas |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/opinion/our-banks-should-come-together-overseas/article20961100.ece1 |access-date=2024-12-05 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}</ref>

In 2003, Ravi was appointed by the Government of India and the [[Reserve Bank of India]] (RBI) as the Chairman of the Technical Experts [[Committee]] for the strategic turnaround of [[Punjab & Sind Bank]]. In 2019, he joined the board of [[SBI Capital Markets|SBI]] Payments Services Pvt. Ltd as a [[Director general|Director]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=SBI PAYMENT SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED {{!}} Investors, Shareholders, Directors and Contact Details {{!}} Zauba Corp |url=https://www.zaubacorp.com/company/SBI-Payment-Services-Private-Limited/U67100MH2010PTC200030 |access-date=2024-12-05 |website=www.zaubacorp.com}}</ref>

Additionally, Ravi has been associated with various organizations in senior roles. He served on the boards of [[UTI Asset Management|UTI Company Pvt Ltd]]., [[SME Rating Agency of India|SMERA Ratings]], [https://www.sbisgcsl.co.in/ SBI-SG Global Securities], STCI Finance, and BOI Merchant Bankers.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Tech 25 Class of 2021 - Sethurathnam Ravi |url=https://www.entrepreneurindia.com/tech25web/sravi.php |access-date=2024-12-05 |website=www.entrepreneurindia.com}}</ref>

Ravi is a frequent speaker at industry events organized by regulatory bodies such as [[The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India|ICAI]], RBI, and [[Securities and Exchange Board of India|SEBI]]. His expertise spans [[corporate governance]], [[Financial regulation in India|financial regulations]], and the [[capital market]]s.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sethurathnam Ravi, Ravi Rajan & Co: Profile and Biography |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/person/15422913 |access-date=2024-12-05 |website=Bloomberg.com |language=en}}</ref>

== Recent appointments ==
In 2023, Ravi was appointed as a Non-Executive Independent Director of the Board of PCBL for an initial term of five consecutive years, starting on 15 March 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=PCBL News - PCBL Announcement, Latest News on PCBL |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/pcbl-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-13276.cms |access-date=2024-12-05 |website=The Economic Times |language=en}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Ravi was born to Dr. T. S. Sethurathnam and Mrs. Sakuntala Sethurathnam. His father, Dr. T. S. Sethurathnam, was the Chairman of the Madhya Pradesh [[Electricity Board]] and [[BSES Yamuna Power Limited|BSES]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=TS Sethuratnam: ऊर्जा के क्षेत्र में अलग पहचान बना चुके डॉ. टीएस सेतुरत्नम नहीं रहे, 95 वर्ष की उम्र में निधन |url=https://www.amarujala.com/business/business-diary/dr-ts-sethuratnam-who-made-a-different-identity-in-the-field-of-energy-passed-away-at-the-age-of-95-2024-01-11 |access-date=2024-12-05 |website=Amar Ujala |language=hi}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-01-12 |title=Dr T S Sethurathnam The Hero Who Revolutionised The Power Sector In India - Taazakhabar News |url=https://taazakhabarnews.com/dr-t-s-sethurathnam-the-hero-who-revolutionised-the-power-sector-in-india/ |access-date=2024-12-05 |language=en-US}}</ref> Ravi is married to Mrs. Bhuvana Ravi, and they have two children, Abhishek Ravi and Akshay Ravi.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dr. TS Sethuratnam, who made a name for himself in energy sector, passes away |url=https://thedailyguardian.com/dr-ts-sethuratnam-who-made-a-name-for-himself-in-the-energy-sector-passes-away/ |access-date=2024-12-05 |website=TheDailyGuardian |language=en}}</ref>

== Interests and advocacy ==
Sethurathnam Ravi is passionate about [[sport]]s, [[gender equality]], [[Climate change|global climate change]], and [[Universal access to education|universal education]]. He is actively involved in causes that promote [[social justice]] and [[Sustainability|environmental sustainability]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Biography |url=https://sethurathnamravi.com/biography/ |access-date=2024-12-05 |website=Sethurathnam Ravi (S Ravi) |language=en-US}}</ref>
